name: Emergency-stop operator
summary: An identified emergency-stop operator and its documented contact arrangement.
description: An emergency-stop operator is identified by its intended function and the properties of the selected device. A schematic may show its contact blocks, actuator and reset or latching features. The drawing must connect those features to the operator description and the complete control-system design.

This educational preview identifies the concept without specifying a safety circuit. A mushroom actuator, NC contact or stop label alone does not establish the required safety performance. Use the applicable standards, risk assessment and manufacturer information for the actual implementation.
readingNotes: Read the operator identification together with all associated contact blocks.
Do not infer safety performance from the actuator shape or a single contact mark.
drawingChecklist: Identify the operator and documented reset mode.
distinction: Emergency stop is a system function. A generic mushroom pushbutton depiction does not certify an emergency-stop implementation.
